headline: Re-estimated on fresh data, ADH's China-shock effect on local manufacturing employment holds through 2012 (−0.42) but fades to zero by 2012–2019 (−0.03) and reverses by 2019–2024 (+0.05) as the shock plateaus and recedes.

tables.title: China-shock 2SLS β by window (frozen-full spec, proxy outcome, per +$1k/worker)

figures.caption: Living update: national-context strip (China import share + US mfg emp/pop) over 4 panels showing each ADH claim's 2SLS coefficient vs time with 95% CI. Shaded = 1990–2007 original sample; dashed = ADH 2013 headline; solid squares = ADH original outcomes; open circles = this study's proxy outcomes; F flagged where first-stage F<10.
figures.alt: Four coefficient-vs-time panels plus a top strip; all four China-shock effects are large in 1990–2012 and collapse to zero after 2012 as the import share plateaus and falls.

figures.caption: Left: mean constructed China-shock exposure per window, peaking in 2000–07 and turning negative by 2019–24. Right: the manufacturing-employment coefficient drifts from −0.42 (2007–12) to +0.05 (2019–24), crossing the ADH −0.60 reference.
figures.alt: Two panels: exposure intensity rising then falling; and the mfg-employment 2SLS coefficient rising from negative toward zero and slightly positive over successive windows.

notes: Outcomes are jobs/BEA-based proxies (CBP mfg jobs per working-age resident; LAUS unemployment/labor force; QCEW mean weekly wage; BEA CAINC35 transfers), not ADH's Census/ACS person-level measures (IPUMS unavailable); levels differ but window-to-window changes are consistent, and the 2000–07 proxy reproduces ADH's original outcomes (e.g. NILF proxy +0.498 vs ADH +0.553).
W4 (2012–2019) is weakly identified (first-stage F=6.9<10); its near-zero estimate is corroborated by the reduced form and the pooled interaction model.

W5 employment weights frozen at 2011; C4 W5 window is 2019–2022 (BEA vintage ends 2022). Exposure built from CEPII BACI (Switzerland corrected to code 757), validated r=0.95 vs the original ADH workfile and r=0.855 vs ADH's Persistence-archive exposure.
722 mainland commuting zones; 2SLS weighted by start-period population, state-clustered SEs; full detail in report.md and results/living_update/estimates_by_window.csv.
